{{Short description|List of the companies in HN Group}}
This is a list of the companies in '''[[HN Group]]''', kept up to date automatically from the HN Group Company Register: when a company is added or changed there, this list changes too. [[Horizon Development]] is part of [[Horizon Network]] rather than a separate company, and [[Horizon Advertising]] is managed by Horizon Network.
